Subject: ACME - Mutual Action Plan & evaluation next steps

Hi John / Sarah —

Great to meet with you earlier — thanks for walking through the evaluation goals and timelines. Attached is the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) I promised during the call. It’s intentionally high-level so we can align on owners and dates quickly. Key items included:

- Pilot scope & success criteria (security, latency, cost targets)
- Evaluation environment & data access
- Timeline: 4–6 week pilot recommended
- Decision criteria and stakeholders

Ask: can you review the MAP and confirm a) who will own each line item on your side, and b) whether the proposed dates (column C) look realistic? I’ve tagged suggested owners where I have context.

Attachment: ACME-MAP-v1.xlsx (Excel)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm owners/dates by Fri 4/29
2) We schedule a 30-minute kickoff to hand off to engineering (suggested week of 5/3)

I’ve CC’d Mateo (solutions engineer) as he’ll join the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

Best,
